verses.original: הַמְשֵׁ֣ל וָפַ֣חַד עִמּ֑וֹ עֹשֶׂ֥ה שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם בִּמְרוֹמָֽיו׃
verses.literal: Dominion and awe belong to [God] He establishes harmony in the heights of heaven

verses.original: הֲיֵ֣שׁ לִגְדוּדָ֑יו מִ֭סְפָּר וְעַל־ מִ֝֗י אוֹרֵֽהוּ׃ לֹא־ יָק֥וּם
verses.transliteration: hă·yêš liḡ·ḏū·ḏāw mis·pār wə·‘al- mî ’ō·w·rê·hū lō- yā·qūm
verses.literal: - Can His troops be numbered On whom does His light not rise

verses.original: וּמַה־ אֱנ֣וֹשׁ יִּצְדַּ֣ק עִם־ אֵ֑ל וּמַה־ יְל֣וּד אִשָּֽׁה׃ יִּ֝זְכֶּ֗ה
verses.literal: How then can a man be just before God How can one born of woman be pure

verses.original: הֵ֣ן עַד־ יָ֭רֵחַ וְלֹ֣א יַאֲהִ֑יל וְ֝כוֹכָבִ֗ים לֹא־ זַכּ֥וּ בְעֵינָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hên ‘aḏ- yā·rê·aḥ wə·lō ya·’ă·hîl wə·ḵō·w·ḵā·ḇîm lō- zak·kū ḇə·‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: If even the moon does not shine and the stars are not pure in His sight

verses.original: אַ֭ף כִּֽי־ אֱנ֣וֹשׁ רִמָּ֑ה וּבֶן־ אָ֝דָ֗ם תּוֹלֵעָֽה׃פ
verses.literal: how much less . . . man who is but a maggot and the son of man who is but a worm
